result.reason: The revision only limits revocability during the Term and remains subject to any termination right in Section 4, without ensuring termination is limited to an uncured material breach. It does not extend the licence to affiliates or contractors, and the express non-transferability/non-assignability fails even the fallback requirement permitting transfer to an M&A successor. It also does not address perpetual treatment for any paid-up licence. Although the change is narrow and generally preserves the original commercial scope, the blank defined term remains unfixed despite the margin comment.
